{
  "dataset_name": "credit_g",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "duration_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized duration using training mean and std for scale-normalized distance.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Equalizes feature scale so duration contributes proportionally to KNN distance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(duration - 22.2067) / 13.2511"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_amount_log_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed credit amount standardized to reduce skew and normalize scale.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses heavy-tailed credit amounts for stable Euclidean distance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(credit_amount) - 7.78) / 0.86"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized age for balanced contribution in neighborhood geometry.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents age scale from dominating or being dominated by other numerics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 35.4667) / 11.0882"
    },
    {
      "name": "installment_burden_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Monthly installment burden proxy: installment commitment times credit amount divided by duration.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20000.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a meaningful similarity dimension separating borrowers by repayment pressure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(installment_commitment * credit_amount) / np.maximum(duration, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_per_month",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average credit amount per month of loan duration.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2000.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures loan intensity as a single distance dimension.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "credit_amount / np.maximum(duration, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_to_duration_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of borrower age to loan duration in months scaled.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Distinguishes young short-loan borrowers from older long-loan ones for neighborhood structure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "age / np.maximum(duration, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dist_to_typical_borrower",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean-like distance from an unsupervised central prototype defined by training means of key numerics.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a global outlierness signal that helps KNN weight atypical rows.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((duration - 22.2067) / 13.2511) ** 2 + ((np.log1p(credit_amount) - 7.78) / 0.86) ** 2 + ((age - 35.4667) / 11.0882) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dist_to_young_smallloan_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Distance from an unsupervised prototype representing young borrowers with small short loans (age=25, duration=12, log credit_amount=7.0).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Anchors a cluster centroid for one common borrower archetype to improve neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((duration - 12.0) / 13.2511) ** 2 + ((np.log1p(credit_amount) - 7.0) / 0.86) ** 2 + ((age - 25.0) / 11.0882) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dist_to_mature_largeloan_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Distance from an unsupervised prototype representing older borrowers with large long-duration loans (age=50, duration=36, log credit_amount=8.6).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a second archetype anchor enabling KNN to localize different borrower regions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((duration - 36.0) / 13.2511) ** 2 + ((np.log1p(credit_amount) - 8.6) / 0.86) ** 2 + ((age - 50.0) / 11.0882) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "stability_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic stability indicator combining housing ownership, employment tenure, residence duration, and job skill into a 0-1 score; higher means more stable life situation. Computed from row values only via ordinal mapping (own housing=1 else 0, employment >=7 years=1 / 4<=X<7=0.75 / 1<=X<4=0.5 / <1=0.25 / unemployed=0, residence_since/4, job skilled or high qualif=1 else 0.5) averaged.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a meaningful low-dimensional similarity axis for KNN to group stable vs unstable applicants.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_buffer_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of financial cushion derived from savings_status, checking_status, and property_magnitude mapped to 0-1 (e.g., savings >=1000=1.0, 500<=X<1000=0.75, 100<=X<500=0.5, <100=0.25, no known savings=0.1; checking >=200=1.0, 0<=X<200=0.6, <0=0.1, no checking=0.4; property real estate=1.0, life insurance=0.7, car=0.5, no known property=0.0) averaged.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses multiple categorical wealth signals into one distance-friendly continuous dimension.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "loan_risk_profile_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic ordinal score from credit_history and purpose riskiness mapped to 0-1 (credit_history: critical/other existing=0.2, delayed previously=0.4, existing paid=0.7, all paid=0.9, no credits/all paid=0.5; purpose: used car/radio-tv/furniture=0.7, new car/business=0.5, education/repairs=0.3, retraining/other/domestic=0.4) averaged.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an interpretable low-dimensional axis enabling KNN to align with credit-quality neighborhoods.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
